result:
I added the three search fields to the Desligamentos screen: Ano, Motivo do Desligamento (the dismissal type) and Nível. I haven't run any of it. The only check was `ruby -c` on the controller, which reported a syntax OK. The spec run I tried, `spec/controllers/dismissals_controller_spec.rb`, found no examples and had an error outside the examples, so it tells us nothing about the change.

- **Ano:** a year dropdown that matches dismissals with a date from 1 January to 31 December of the chosen year. I used a date range instead of extracting the year from the date so it works on both MySQL and SQLite.
- **Tipo de desligamento:** a select on the dismissal reason.
- **Nível:** a select on the enrollment's level, reusing the existing `add_enrollment_level_search_column` helper that the class-enrollment screens use.

The changes are in `app/controllers/dismissals_controller.rb`, plus the "Ano" and "Nível" labels in `config/locales/dismissal.pt-BR.yml`.

Next, open the Desligamentos screen and try each filter, and run the dismissals specs again once that error is sorted out.
